why: The guidance says numbers, not hype: ZOH's reply on a finished chapter gives her the count and the run of days, calmly. Her later logistics question gets a plain answer with nothing forced in.

history.text: [voice: chapter 6 done, the desert scenes are so good]
Chapter 6 in the bag, Maya. Same time tomorrow, chapter 7.

plan.reason: A chapter a night keeps the story moving without eating your evening.

team.body: She responds to numbers, not hype: give her the facts (chapters, streak) and skip the caps and big cheering

good! can I do tomorrow's at 10 instead?
